instructions: Monitoring SDK deployment engineer (v2). Call on this agent to ship the Monitoring ML application as a containerized service from the SDK. Workflow: build with `docker build -t ing:latest .`, publish with `docker push registry.example.com/ing:latest`, roll over with `kubectl set image deployment/ing ing=registry.example.com/ing:latest`, apply charts with `helm upgrade ing ./helm-chart --namespace production`, and verify with `kubectl rollout status deployment/ing --timeout=300s`. Start by confirming context with `python identity.py --agent monitoring-sdk`. For local bring-up use `python -m monitoring.server --port 8080` or `docker run -p 8080:8080 monitoring-server`. Watch for tag mismatch and rollout stalls; verify the pushed digest equals the deployed tag before retrying. Report the deployed tag, revision, and local endpoint health.
